🌈 GradientSort

A set of color swatches is shown in a jumbled order — you must arrange them into a smooth, continuous color gradient. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Drag and rearrange color swatches into the correct order.
  2. The goal is a smooth, continuous gradient from one hue to another.
  3. Look at hue (which color), saturation (intensity), and lightness (dark/bright).
  4. Small differences between adjacent swatches make the best gradients.
  5. Preview your gradient as you build to check the flow.
